title: v3.0.0 - FULL RELEASE
text:
- 18k + games added.
- 1k + Movies for FREE.
- Built in Proxy
- 10k + new themes
- 10 new UI layout
- Fixed how Fullscreening works.
- Make profile pictures (PFPs) appear next to people's messages in chat.
- Combine consecutive messages from the same person, similar to Discord.
- Fix Fullscreen functionality.
- Fix opening the app in `about:blank`.
- Fix games only displaying a white screen when loading.
- Make notifications (new updates, banners, friend requests, etc.) stay marked as read after saving and returning later.
- Make themes and layouts load instantly when a user logs in.
- Change the minimize symbol from `[_]` to `[-]`.
- Make the username in the corner display the user's display name instead of their username.
- Fix Bento's top navigation bar having an oversized scrollbar due to cramped buttons.
- Fix the desktop layout's search bar autocomplete suggestions to appear above the search bar instead of below it.
- Improve the appearance of all scrollbars throughout the app.

title: v1.2.0 - Layouts, Friends & Chat Update
text:
- Added 3 layouts: Terminal, Desktop and Bento
- Added a Design button for layouts, themes and your own background image
- Added a theme gallery to share and browse themes
- Added a startup animation (can be turned off)
- Added a new login screen: sign up with just a username
- Added guest access with an access token
- Added profile pictures, display names and profile cards
- Added a Who's online list and a combined online counter
- Added Friends with requests, online status and blocking
- Added Public chat with report, mute and auto-hide
- Added an Alerts button for friend requests and announcements
- Added Polls
- Added like and dislike ratings on games, plus a Top rated filter
- Added playtime tracking and a Continue playing row
- Added your own links on the Desktop and Bento layouts
- Added a Show desktop button and better window snapping
- Added a phone layout
- Added a welcome tour for new users
- Added auto-save by default and older cloud saves you can restore
- Added change username and change password
- Added rules and privacy notice, with a 13+ check at sign-up
- Added an announcement banner
- Fixed the announcement banner not clearing
